scope: Original decrypted machine instructions with explicit platform/runtime shims, compared against independent behavioral reconstructions. No vendor binary bytes included in these files.
countDefinition: Movement: 8 constructor cases x 2 binary/model comparisons plus 3209 samples x 2 comparisons (watch/phone parity and watch/reference). Other components count one comparison per case. Additional model-vs-saved-output checks are not added again.
limitations: Not a complete app launch, overnight hardware validation, or clinical accuracy validation.
ARM64_32 was statically cross-checked separately; these executable probes run ARM64.
Synthetic finite motion, timestamps, Swift metadata, Foundation Date operations, object lifetimes and notification fixtures replace the platform environment.
vDSP mean and libc exp use Python numerical equivalents; comparisons use the stated floating-point tolerance rather than claiming bit-identical platform math.

The lifecycle probe executes the dispatcher, alarm decision, armed filter and runtime expiry predicate; its phase-change callback supplies phase state and previously selected calibration inputs. It does not execute historical mode/filter selection at 0x1000989f0.

The history probe executes the rate calculation and recursive search; effective session end is supplied. Effective-end selection, calibration entry guards, D getter and recorder event binning are statically traced in the reference and specifications, not separately emulated by this suite.
Alarm firing is observed at the callback boundary. Actual haptics, audio, runtime scheduling, expiration callbacks, OS recovery and HealthKit interfaces remain outside this suite.

WatchMovementProbe.py.scope: Original decrypted watch and phone FastMovementAnalyzer instructions executed with framework/runtime shims; no sensor hardware, scheduler, or complete app execution.

WatchAlarmParameterProbe.py.scope: Original watch ARM64 instructions 0x10009C03C through 0x10009C17C; stopped before logging. Only runtime field-offset globals supplied; no algorithm stubs.

WatchAlarmRuleProbe.py.scope: Actual ARM64 checkForAlarm rule core original instructions at 0x1000997e0..0x100099fdc. Entry requires current alarm, future deadline, no delegate override. Date, Swift metadata/copy/exclusivity and logging are shimmed. Fire callback observed rather than run; upstream deadline/delegate/acquisition are outside this probe.

WatchArmedFilterProbe.py.scope: Original complete ARM64 extendedFilterForArmedPhase instructions at 0x10009a704, with Date, Swift metadata/copy and logging shims. Synthetic movement input and field offsets; no sensor hardware or app scheduling.

WatchHistoryCalibrationProbe.py.scope: Complete original ARM64 event-rate 0x10008bbf4 and recursive calibration search 0x10008ca8c instructions. Framework Date/Swift allocation/refcount/exclusivity shims; session effectiveEnd supplied, not evaluated. Native-array fixtures include cutoff/intensity boundaries and future-date behavior.

WatchAlarmLifecycleProbe.py.scope:
Execute watch alarm entry guards, runtime-expiration predicate and dispatcher.

Runs original 0x99334 including 0x36e74, and original dispatcher 0x9af74 with
original movement filter and alarm decision. Phase-change callback supplies the
separately tested calibration result; it is not part of this probe's coverage.
Foundation/Combine/Notification/Swift runtime accesses are synthetic fixtures.
